Messages.Author: craigs...@gmail.com
Messages.Body:
The Admonitions

Put this card in play. Tap to discard one card if you control a ready
Sabbat vampire. Tap to draw two cards if you control a ready Black
Hand vampire. During your discard phase, control of The Admonitions
passes counter-clockwise until it is controlled by a Methuselah who
controls a ready Sabbat vampire (or is burned if there are none).

Choice question:

"Tap to discard one card if you control a ready Sabbat vampire."
"Tap to draw two cards if you control a ready Black Hand vampire."

If I control Blackhorse Tanner, who is both Sabbat and Black Hand, can
I choose which of the 2 effects I may trigger?

Timing question:

Most effects which cause the user to draw extra cards also tell the
user when to discard them:

Fragment of the Book of Nod:
"Tap to draw 2 cards from your library. Discard down to your hand
size."
Dreams of the Sphinx:
Tap this card to draw two cards and increase your hand size by two
cards until the end of the current turn.
Aura Reading:
Your hand size is increased by 2 cards for the remainder of this
combat. Discard down to your hand size at the end of combat.

The Admonitions simply says:
"Tap to draw two cards"

...so I assume my hand size is +2 for as long as I control The
Admonitions. Is this correct?

Eg 1) It's a 2-player game, both of us have 7-card hands. Bob plays
The Admonitions but doesn't tap it. During his discard phase, I get
The Admonitions, and "Tap to draw two cards" immediately, putting me
on 9 cards. A few seconds later, in my untap phase, I again "Tap to
draw two cards", and thus I have an 11-card hand until my discard
phase.

Eg 2) It's a 2-player game, both of us have 7-card hands. Bob has no
Sabbat in play. I play The Admonitions, and "Tap to draw two cards"
immediately, putting me on 9 cards. During my discard phase, control
of The Admonitions passes counter-clockwise to Bob, forcing me to drop
to 7 cards, and then, still in my discard phase, control passes back
to me.

Eg 3) It's a 2-player game. Bob has no Sabbat in play. I play The
Admonitions, and leave it untapped. During my discard phase, control
of The Admonitions passes counter-clockwise to Bob, and then, still in
my discard phase, control passes back to me. I tap it, putting me on
9 cards during Bob's turn. When it gets back to my turn, I tap the
Admonitions immediately, giving me 11 cards to use during my turn.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
craigs...@gmail.com wrote:
> The Admonitions
>
> Put this card in play. Tap to discard one card if you control a ready
> Sabbat vampire. Tap to draw two cards if you control a ready Black
> Hand vampire. During your discard phase, control of The Admonitions
> passes counter-clockwise until it is controlled by a Methuselah who
> controls a ready Sabbat vampire (or is burned if there are none).
>
> Choice question:
>
> "Tap to discard one card if you control a ready Sabbat vampire."
> "Tap to draw two cards if you control a ready Black Hand vampire."
>
> If I control Blackhorse Tanner, who is both Sabbat and Black Hand, can
> I choose which of the 2 effects I may trigger?

Yes.

> Timing question:
>
> Most effects which cause the user to draw extra cards also tell the
> user when to discard them:
>
> Fragment of the Book of Nod:
> "Tap to draw 2 cards from your library. Discard down to your hand
> size."
> Dreams of the Sphinx:
> Tap this card to draw two cards and increase your hand size by two
> cards until the end of the current turn.
> Aura Reading:
> Your hand size is increased by 2 cards for the remainder of this
> combat. Discard down to your hand size at the end of combat.
>
> The Admonitions simply says:
> "Tap to draw two cards"
>

> ....so I assume my hand size is +2 for as long as I control The
> Admonitions. Is this correct?

No. It doesn't change your hand size.

Section 1.6.1.2 of the rules: "The number of cards in your hand should always
match your hand size (less any cards you are not replacing until later).
Whenever they don't match (when an effect changes your hand size or adds or
removes cards from your hand, for example), immediately discard down to or draw
up to your hand size."

Note that the text you quote for Dreams also doesn't remind you to discard.

See also The Barrens.

> Eg 1) It's a 2-player game, both of us have 7-card hands. Bob plays
> The Admonitions but doesn't tap it. During his discard phase, I get
> The Admonitions, and "Tap to draw two cards" immediately, putting me
> on 9 cards. A few seconds later, in my untap phase, I again "Tap to
> draw two cards", and thus I have an 11-card hand until my discard
> phase.

You tap it on Bob's turn to draw two cards. You immediately discard down to your
hand size.

And again on your own untap phase.
